phenomenon_citation: ANP is secreted by atrial myocytes in response to atrial wall stretch and increases renal sodium excretion in humans. Morice A et al. Clin Sci 1988;74:359-363, PMID 2965631. Biollaz J et al. Hypertension 1986;8:II96-105, PMID 2941372. See ADR 0010 for the full evidence table.
form_citation: FIRST-ORDER LAG, and the lag is the sourced part of the form rather than a convenience. Drummer C, Heer M, Baisch F, Blomqvist CG, Lang RE, Maass H, Gerzer R. Acta Physiol Scand Suppl 1992;604:101-11, PMID 1324562: 6 healthy men given 0.9% saline 22 mL/kg excreted under 15% of the sodium acutely, remained in positive balance, and had significantly elevated sodium excretion beyond 48 h; the authors conclude that excretion of an acute isotonic load requires several days. An ALGEBRAIC form was implemented first and REFUTED - it cannot carry the acute and chronic limbs at once, which differ by a factor of 2.5. Linearity in the volume error is NOT sourced and is the same assumption the pressure-natriuresis term makes.
notes: ADR 0010, unblocked and turned ON 2026-09-02. THE SENSED VARIABLE IS BLOOD VOLUME because atrial stretch is intravascular; ADR 0010 proposed V_blood and Renal.jl was re-keyed from V_ecf the same day, the two differing by f_pv = 0.211. THE GAIN IS INTENSIVE: it multiplies a volume, which already scales with body size, so unlike G_pn it must NOT scale - written extensive first and caught within one run by the body-size testset, which lost mass-invariance of the salt-step shift. WHAT IT FIXED, measured by validation/challenges.jl: acute fractional sodium excretion on isotonic expansion went from +43% against a human +123% to +79%, and Lobo 2001 is now reproduced at 575 mL and 96.3 mmol over 6 h against a measured 563 mL and 95 mmol. Chronic salt sensitivity fell 4.958 to 2.301 mmHg per 100 mmol/day, inside the human 1.70-2.30. WHAT IT BROKE, and it is a real prediction rather than a defect: salt sensitivity is now SEX-DEPENDENT, women 11% higher, because the path is keyed to a sexed volume. Nothing in this repo has sourced that and it is recorded as debt.
